en.hubeali: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Hammad Bin Isa, from Hareyz, from Zurara who said,

‘Abu Ja’farasws said: ‘The time for Maghrib is when the disc disappears (the sun sets). So when you see it (the sun) after that, and you have already prayed Salāt, so repeat the Salāt, and continue your Fast, and refrain from the food, if you have taken something from it’.
en.sarwar: 5. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from Hammad ibn Isa from Hariz from Zurarah who has said the following:

"Abu Ja’far, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ’It is time of al-Maghrib when the disc disappears, (sunset takes place). If you see the disc latter when you have already performed Salah (prayer), you must perform Salah (prayer) again, continue fasting, avoid eating if you have taken anything of food.’”
